scope: Unity city map visual and interaction enhancement

full_suite.targeted_recheck: passed after concurrent combat changes; full suite was not repeated

assets.method: Original deterministic procedural art; no commercial game pixels sampled

manual_ui: Native window opened and observed; further pointer input stopped because concurrent user input was detected. Drag/hover behavior was not manually signed off. Camera projection and inverse were checked across every tile at four zoom levels.
hidden_probe: output/city-map/acceptance was a preliminary hidden-window run; its black screenshots are excluded from visual acceptance. The visible run validates pixel diversity.
save_policy: All acceptance and UI actions used isolated output/city-map test saves. No official save was supplied to acceptance.
